Grand marshal and chariot-and-cavalry general Xu Jia and twenty-nine others considered that Emperor Xiaowen abolished laws against slander, removed mutilating punishments, personally was frugal and restrained, did not accept presents, criminals were not punished with confiscation of kin, did not privatize profit for himself, released the fair ladies, heavily cut off human lines, hospitably bestowed on the aged, gathered and pitied the orphaned and alone—virtue thick matching Heaven and Earth, benefit and grace extending to the four seas—he ought to be the Grand Exemplar temple for the one who is emperor.
